svg.desc: ТПТС KO (пошаговое управление) для Dull Screen

rt:var.name: ProgrColor
rt:var.comment: Код цвета для значка текущей программы

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:var.name: AckSupport
rt:var.comment: Фиктивная переменная, означающая, что данный объект поддерживает самоквитирование по функции AckMe()

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub AckMe() If Check_Oper_Rights(OU) && ((OU.PVSuspendedFlags & PLS_SUSP_CMD) == 0) && ((AStat & 1) != 0) Then Dim F1 As PlsPVBin Dim F2 As PlsPVBin F1 = BIN(KKS + "_F1") If F1 != Nothing Then F2 = BIN(KKS + "_F2") If F2 != Nothing Then 'классическое квитирование 'Квитирование для состояний ОСТАНОВ If ((F1.Value & 128) > 0) || ((F2.Value & 1) > 0) Then PRJSPEC.Operate(KKS, KO_BHB) 'Квитирование для состояний ПУСК ElseIf ((F1.Value & 256) > 0) || ((F2.Value & 2) > 0) Then PRJSPEC.Operate(KKS, KO_BHS) 'Проталкивание для состояний ПУСК ElseIf ((F1.Value & 1024) > 0) Then PRJSPEC.Operate(KKS, KO_BHB_FTI) 'Проталкивание для состояний ОСТВНОВ ElseIf ((F1.Value & 512) > 0) Then PRJSPEC.Operate(KKS, KO_BHS_FTI) End If End If End If End If End Sub

Sub StatusCount () Dim StepN As String Dim Use_Z0 As Boolean Use_Z0 = False ProgrColor = 0 body.fill_opacity = 0.35 If (Z0 == Nothing) Then //без Z0 считается ошибка привязки BGColor = 14 AStat = 0 body.fill_opacity = 1 Exit Sub Else 'Если можно обрабатывать запрашиваемые сигналы If requests_allown && (VB17 != Nothing) Then If (VB17.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && ((VB17.Value & 14) != 0) Then If (VB17.Value & 14) == 2 Then BGColor = 4 'CFG_COLOR_T ElseIf (VB17.Value & 14) == 4 Then BGColor = 2 'CFG_COLOR_H ElseIf (VB17.Value & 14) == 8 Then BGColor = 3 'CFG_COLOR_A Else BGColor = 9 'Col_Grey2 End If Else Use_Z0 = True End If Else Use_Z0 = True End If
If Use_Z0 Then If (Z0.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) && ((Z0.Value & 0x7c0) == 0) Then If (Z0.Value & 7) == 1Then BGColor = 2 'CFG_COLOR_H ElseIf (Z0.Value & 7) == 2 Then BGColor = 3 'CFG_COLOR_A ElseIf (Z0.Value & 7) == 4 Then BGColor = 4 'CFG_COLOR_T Else BGColor = 9 'Col_Grey2 End If Else BGColor = 15 'CFG_COLOR_INVALID body.fill_opacity = 1 End If End If 'теперь определяем и ставим код мигания программы и рамки неисправности If requests_allown Then 'можно обрабатывать запрашиваемые сигналы If (VB17 == Nothing) Then AStat = 0 Branch_mode = False ElseIf (VB17.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then AStat = 0 Branch_mode = False Else Branch_mode = ((VB17.Value & 1) != 0) AStat = ((VB17.Value & 0xC00) / 0x400) If (VB17.Value & 0x240) > 0 Then ProgrColor = 16 ElseIf (VB17.Value & 0x90) > 0 Then ProgrColor = 64 End If End If End If End If
'определяем номер шага If !requests_allown Then 'нельзя обрабатывать запрашиваемые сигналы If (ANA_CurStep == Nothing) Then StepStr = "??" Else StepStr = CStr(CInt(ANA_CurStep.Value)) If (ANA_CurStep.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then Cur_step_bg.fill = Color_Inval Else Cur_step_bg.fill = "url(#Circle_LeftFront)" End If End If ElseIf (VB28 == Nothing) Then If (ANA_CurStep == Nothing) Then StepStr = "--" Else StepStr = CStr(CInt(ANA_CurStep.Value)) If (ANA_CurStep.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then Cur_step_bg.fill = Color_Inval Else Cur_step_bg.fill = "url(#Circle_LeftFront)" End If End If Else StepStr = CStr( (VB28.Value & 0xF) + 10 * CInt((VB28.Value & 0xF0) / 16) ) If (VB28.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then Cur_step_bg.fill = Color_Inval Else Cur_step_bg.fill = "url(#Circle_LeftFront)" End If End If
'определяем специальные состояния If PRJSPEC.GET_Susp(KKS, True) Then 'ремонт AStat = 0 BGColor = 6 'CFG_COLOR_REMONT body.fill_opacity = 1 ProgrColor = 0 Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Repair_mode.visibility = "visible" Exit Sub Else Repair_mode.visibility = "hidden" End If Dim DetectByZ0 As Boolean DetectByZ0 = False If ((Z0.Value & 0x7C0) != 0) Then 'недостоверность AStat = 0 BGColor = 15 'CFG_COLOR_INVALID body.fill_opacity = 1 ProgrColor = 0 Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "X" ElseIf (VB17 == Nothing) && (Z0.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then 'нельзя определить программу Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" ElseIf (VB17 != Nothing) Then If (VB17.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then If ((VB17.Value & 0x380) != 0) && ((VB17.Value & 0x70) == 0) Then 'программа ПУСК If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "visible" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "1" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If ElseIf ((VB17.Value & 0x70) != 0) && ((VB17.Value & 0x380) == 0) Then 'программа ОСТАНОВ If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "visible" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "2" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" End If Else DetectByZ0 = True End If ElseIf (Z0.Quality != PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then DetectByZ0 = True Else 'нельзя определить программу Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" End If If DetectByZ0 Then If ((Z0.Value & 0x18) == 0x10) Then 'программа ПУСК If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "visible" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "1" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If ElseIf ((Z0.Value & 0x18) == 8) Then 'программа ОСТАНОВ If StopStart Then Progr_bg.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "visible" Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.visibility = "visible" Prog_num.text = "2" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" End If Else Progr_bg.visibility = "visible" Progr_start.visibility = "hidden" Progr_stop.visibility = "hidden" Prog_num.visibility = "hidden" End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (KKS != "NULL") Then Z0 = BIN(KKS + "_Z0") OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") If requests_allown Then VB17 = BIN(KKS + "_VB17") VB28 = BIN(KKS + "_VB28") End If If !requests_allown || (VB28 == Nothing) Then ANA_CurStep = ANA(KKS + "_" + Signal_KO_Cur_Step) End If Else BGColor = 14 AStat = 0 body.fill_opacity = 1 End If

rect.rt:event: If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then Open_ws_wf_wi("TPTS_KO_6", KKS + "|" + CStr(StopStart), Operate) Else NoLink(KKS) End If

If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|KO o|TPTS_KO_6 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(StopStart)) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|KO i|TPTS_KO_6 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(StopStart)) End If Else NoLink(KKS) End If
If KKS == "NULL" Then ShowMessage ("Объект не привязан.", 5) ElseIf Z0 != nothing Then Open_Win_Uni(False, "rights", "Права управления", "wi_rights", KKS+"|"+CStr(Operate)) Else NoLink(KKS) End If
